profile.headline: Software Engineer at L3Harris Corporation
profile.summary:
Work:
  • Software Engineer Intern, Performance & Testing COOP
Research:
  • Line of Sight for Object Detection
Organization:
  • UPRM Roboboat - Software Lead | Vision Member
  • Computer Alliance of Hispanic-Serving Institutions
  • IEEE Computer Society
  • CodePath University

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software design and development for company special projects

positions.title: Software Lead | Vision Developer
positions.description:
• Organize task assignment and meetings to analyze and maintain project progress to the predefined  projection
• Design the software of an autonomous boat that must complete object detection, collision avoidance and signal analysis tasks.
• Design and implement the “Vision” code and system to include the necessary and efficient algorithms.
• A vision test environment was set up for design and testing of code using: Raspberry Pi 3, Raspicam, GPIO Exp.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Member of the “Rainier Program” that is in charge of Point Cloud Data Collection.
• Work assigned was related to Database code fixes and project data size tracking implementation.
• Persistent project data size tracking was now possible throughout the database and different Rainier tools.

positions.title: Performance and Testing COOP
positions.description:
• Part of the Websphere Application Server group as a member of the Performance team.
• Performance analysis was done utilizing benchmark and profiling tools to observe CPU resource usage and response times of a web application that uses IBM products.
• Automized part of the performance analysis process by creating bash scripts that used arguments to execute benchmark runs with the corresponding quantity of injection rates and driver agents.

positions.title: Saveory Web Application COOP Project
positions.description:
• Development of a sample web application of a Microservice architecture that utilized MicroService Builder (MSB) and IBM Cloud Private.
• Virtual Pantry web application named Saveory was developed with the purpose of helping people to manage their food and cook meals.
• A front-end was developed using React and it communicated with 3 backend microservices that were implemented using the MicroService Builder default setup for a Java applications to fulfill different user requests.
• Other utilized tools/software: Docker, Jenkins, JAX-RS, Maven, MongoDB, Bash
